'''Rod Latham Hoth: Clouds''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls6.htm Hoth: Clouds], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319193319/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls6.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
